verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר׃ נוֹדָ֣ע בִּֽיהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּד֥וֹל שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nōṯ miz·mō·wr lə·’ā·sāp̄ šîr nō·w·ḏā‘ bî·hū·ḏāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·yiś·rā·’êl gā·ḏō·wl šə·mōw
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments A Psalm of Asaph A song God is known in Judah His name is great in Israel
verses.literalPt: Conhecido é Deus em Judá; em Israel, grande é o seu nome.

verses.literal: His tent is in Salem His dwelling place in Zion
verses.literalPt: Em Salém, é o seu tabernáculo; e a sua morada, em Sião.

verses.original: שָׁ֭מָּה שִׁבַּ֣ר רִשְׁפֵי־ קָ֑שֶׁת מָגֵ֬ן וְחֶ֖רֶב וּמִלְחָמָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: šām·māh šib·bar riš·p̄ê- qā·šeṯ mā·ḡên wə·ḥe·reḇ ū·mil·ḥā·māh se·lāh
verses.literal: There He shattered the flaming arrows . . . the shield and sword and weapons of war Selah
verses.literalPt: Ali, quebrou ele as setas do arco, o escudo, a espada e a batalha. (Selá)

verses.literal: You are resplendent with light more majestic than mountains filled with game
verses.literalPt: Ilustre és tu, majestoso, vindo do monte de presa.

verses.original: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְל֨וּ׀ אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑ם וְלֹא־ מָצְא֖וּ כָל־ אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֣יִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eš·tō·wl·lū ’ab·bî·rê lêḇ nā·mū šə·nā·ṯām wə·lō- mā·ṣə·’ū ḵāl ’an·šê- ḥa·yil yə·ḏê·hem
verses.literal: The valiant . . . lie plundered they sleep their last sleep No . . . men of might could lift a hand
verses.literalPt: Despojados são os corajosos de coração; caíram no seu último sono; e nenhum dos valentes pode defender-se.

verses.original: מִ֭גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְרֶ֣כֶב וָסֽוּס׃
verses.literal: At Your rebuke O God of Jacob both horse and rider lie stunned
verses.literalPt: À tua repreensão, ó Deus de Jacó, tanto carros como cavalos são lançados num profundo sono.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה׀ נ֥וֹרָא אַ֗תָּה וּמִֽי־ יַעֲמֹ֥ד לְפָנֶ֗יךָ מֵאָ֥ז אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.literal: You alone are to be feared When You are angry who can stand before You
verses.literalPt: Tu, sim, tu és para ser temido; e quem te pode resistir uma vez que te irares?

verses.original: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃
verses.literal: From heaven You pronounced judgment and the earth feared and was still
verses.literalPt: Lá do céu, fizeste ouvir a tua sentença; temeu a terra e ficou imóvel,

verses.original: בְּקוּם־ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט אֱלֹהִ֑ים לְהוֹשִׁ֖יעַ כָּל־ עַנְוֵי־ אֶ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.literal: when God rose up to judge to save all the lowly of the earth Selah
verses.literalPt: ao levantar-se Deus para julgar, para salvar todos os mansos da terra. (Selá)

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תּוֹדֶ֑ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥă·maṯ ’ā·ḏām tō·w·ḏe·kā šə·’ê·rîṯ ḥê·mōṯ taḥ·gōr
verses.literal: Even the wrath of man shall praise You with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, a ira do homem redundará em teu louvor; da ira restante tu te cingirás.

verses.original: נִֽדֲר֣וּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ֮ לַיהוָ֪ה אֱ‍ֽלֹהֵ֫יכֶ֥ם כָּל־ סְבִיבָ֑יו יוֹבִ֥ילוּ שַׁ֝֗י לַמּוֹרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ni·ḏă·rū wə·šal·lə·mū Yah·weh ’ĕlō·hê·ḵem kāl- sə·ḇî·ḇāw yō·w·ḇî·lū šay lam·mō·w·rā
verses.literal: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared
verses.literalPt: Fazei votos e pagai-os a Jeová, vosso Deus; todos os que o rodeiam, tragam presentes àquele que deve ser temido.

verses.original: יִ֭בְצֹר ר֣וּחַ נְגִידִ֑ים נ֝וֹרָ֗א לְמַלְכֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: He breaks the spirits of princes He is feared by the kings of the earth
verses.literalPt: Ele quebrantará o espírito dos príncipes; é formidável aos reis da terra.
